tyrion_veltras.name: Tyrion Veltras

canon_ref.note: Named in 3.42 (Typhenous reports to him); first seen here. He has not met Magnolia in four years. Class level not given.

tyrion_veltras.summary: The head of House Veltras, a stern lord and warrior with great sway over the northern nobles. He wants the Drakes bled by the Goblins before the Humans move on Liscor.

patricia_melissar.name: Patricia Melissar

canon_ref.note: Hosts the gathering and is murdered there (b5.b_patricia_melissar_murdered_at_the_gathering). Class not named.

patricia_melissar.summary: The lady of House Melissar, who hosts the northern nobles' meeting.

eliasor.name: Eliasor

canon_ref.note: Nine years old. Surname not given in this chapter; assumed House Melissar because Magnolia names him its head.

eliasor.summary: Patricia Melissar's young son. After her murder, Magnolia names him head of his house.

bethal.name: Bethal

canon_ref.note: The ebook gives no surname here. The wiki surname comes from the web serial and is not used.

bethal.summary: A fierce lady of the north and an old friend of Magnolia's. She suspects Magnolia of sending an assassin, then joins her circle again.

thomast.name: Thomast

canon_ref.note: Uses the Skill [Affair of Honor] to force a duel. Class not named. He is at Bethal's side.

thomast.summary: A quiet noble swordsman who kills the assassin in a duel of honour.

pryde.name: Pryde

canon_ref.note: Named only; she joins Magnolia's re-formed circle.

pryde.summary: A northern noble whom Magnolia calls back to her side.

wuvren.name: Wuvren

canon_ref.note: Named only; she joins Magnolia's re-formed circle.

wuvren.summary: A northern noble whom Magnolia calls back to her side.

zanthia.name: Zanthia

canon_ref.note: Named only; she joins Magnolia's re-formed circle.

zanthia.summary: A northern noble whom Magnolia calls back to her side.

venith_crusland.name: Venith Crusland

canon_ref.note: History only (4.00K-4.06K). Skill [Flawless Defence]. Refuses Flos in 4.02K, rejoins him in 4.05K.

venith_crusland.summary: An old vassal of Flos who once tried to kill him for a bounty, then served him. He duels Flos, refuses him, and then rides to save him.

maresar.name: Maresar

canon_ref.note: History only. Once a [Bandit Lord]. Venith's wife. Leads Reim's archers.

maresar.summary: Venith's wife, a former bandit leader and a deadly archer. She joins Flos before her husband does.

calac_crusland.name: Calac Crusland

canon_ref.note: History only. Tries to spear Flos in 4.02K; warns Mars of the ambush in 4.05K.

calac_crusland.summary: Venith and Maresar's son, who hates Flos at first and later warns Reim of an ambush.

tengrip.name: Tengrip

canon_ref.note: History only. Retired; his wrist is broken in the ambush (4.05K).

tengrip.summary: An old retired soldier of Reim who takes up his axe again for his king.

uleth.name: Uleth

canon_ref.note: History only. Very likely killed by [Storm Keep] in 4.05K. The date in our calendar is unknown, so he is dead at the start of Book 5 data.

uleth.summary: The general of the six-nation army that marched on Reim.

siyal.name: Siyal

canon_ref.note: History only. Son of Queen Calliope; Flos killed his father, King Treland.

siyal.summary: The Prince of Hellios, who leads his nation into the war against Reim.

anith.name: Anith

canon_ref.note: Of the Duskclaw Tribe. Skills [Seeking Arrows], [Repulsion Barrier], [Dangersense]. Level not given.

anith.summary: The Jackal Beastkin [Mage] who leads the Silver-rank team Vuliel Drae, careful and bookish.

insill.name: Insill

canon_ref.note: Black scales. His trap-finding Skill misses a rune that Toren spots. Level not given.

insill.summary: The black-scaled Drake [Rogue] of Vuliel Drae, who scouts for traps.

pekona.name: Pekona

canon_ref.note: Her class comes from 'where she is from'; the place is not named. She teaches Toren her moves.

pekona.summary: A Human [Blade Dancer] of Vuliel Drae who fights with spinning, acrobatic sword work.

dasha.name: Dasha

canon_ref.note: Part-Dwarf from Terandria, raised by Dwarves. Fights with an axe; Skill [Impact Charge]. Class not named.

dasha.summary: The axe fighter of Vuliel Drae, part-Dwarf and proud of it, badly hurt by the not-Gnolls.

larr.name: Larr

canon_ref.note: Of the Hawkarrow Tribe. Skill [Triple Shot]. Class not named. He takes a not-Gnoll's head as proof.

larr.summary: The Gnoll archer of Vuliel Drae.

ishkr.name: Ishkr

canon_ref.note: Red-brown fur, born in Liscor; Krshia sends him. Level 16 [Waiter].

ishkr.summary: A quiet Gnoll who works at the Wandering Inn from 4.14 L.

yellow_splatters.name: Yellow Splatters

canon_ref.note: Named by his paint. The first Soldier seen using a Skill (4.13 L); Pawn makes him a [Sergeant] (4.15 L).

yellow_splatters.summary: One of Pawn's painted Soldiers, marked with yellow paint.

thrissiam_blackwing.name: Thrissiam Blackwing

canon_ref.note: [Lineholder General]; Skill [Crescent Arc]. Dies on 'Day 66' and rises undead.

thrissiam_blackwing.summary: The Pallassian general who leads the Drake armies against the Goblin Lord.

garusa_weatherfur.name: Garusa Weatherfur

canon_ref.note: Of the Longstride Clan. A [General] of Zel's alliance. Killed by the Necromancer on 'Day 66'.

garusa_weatherfur.summary: The Gnoll general who brings the Trisstral Alliance's army against the Goblin Lord.

osthia_blackwing.name: Osthia Blackwing

canon_ref.note: Captain of the Ancestor Guard. Yellow scales, wings, acid breath. Thrissiam's niece (also called cousin).

osthia_blackwing.summary: A winged Oldblood captain of Pallass, taken alive by the Goblin Lord.

wailant_strongheart.name: Wailant Strongheart

canon_ref.note: Garia's father. Says he was a Level 27 [Pirate] of Baleros who bought his bounty away; his family rolls their eyes.

wailant_strongheart.summary: Garia's father, a tattooed farmer with a pirate's past.

viceria_strongheart.name: Viceria Strongheart

canon_ref.note: Garia's mother. A [Green Mage] from Wistram; met Wailant on the Blood Fields.

viceria_strongheart.summary: Garia's mother, a Wistram mage who farms.

quallet_marshhand.name: Quallet Marshhand

canon_ref.note: Captain of Gravetender's Fist, a company that burns the dead and kills the undead on battlefields.

quallet_marshhand.summary: A hard, practical mercenary captain who recruits the stranded Earthers into his undead-clearing company, then joins Geneva's new company.

kenjiro_murata.name: Kenjiro Murata

canon_ref.note: Ken. Japanese business student, 21, taken from a Melbourne airport. [Negotiator] Level 18 is stated in 1.06D.

kenjiro_murata.summary: A polite Japanese student who talks his way between armies, becomes a Red Cross medic, and speaks for Geneva when she walks out of the valley.

aiko_nonomura.name: Aiko Nonomura

canon_ref.note: Japanese illustration student, 22. Draws hygiene and bandaging guides. No class named.

aiko_nonomura.summary: A Japanese art student who fights with a spear, then becomes Geneva's surgical assistant and kills an assassin with scalpels.

luan_khumalo.name: Luan Khumalo

canon_ref.note: South African, 25, an Olympic rowing hopeful. Married with a young child on Earth. His [Medic] class is implied only.

luan_khumalo.summary: A tall South African rower who survives an enchanted arrow thanks to Geneva and carries her wounded as a Red Cross medic.

daly.name: Daly

canon_ref.note: Australian. Classes named: [Rogue] (1.03D), [Warrior] and [Axe Fighter] (1.06D). No levels.

daly.summary: A blond Australian who leads the Earthers who stay with Gravetender's Fist, then joins Geneva's new company.

paige.name: Paige

canon_ref.note: Australian. A scarred bite on one arm.

paige.summary: An Australian Earther in Gravetender's Fist, one of those who stay with Daly.

johanas.name: Johanas

canon_ref.note: American. Beheaded by Dullahans in 1.04D for deserting.

johanas.summary: A loud American Earther who leads the Americans' desertion and is executed for it.

quexa.name: Quexa

canon_ref.note: Blue scales. Loses a leg and her tail in 1.06D; Daly carves her a new leg.

quexa.summary: A chatty Lizardfolk fire mage in Gravetender's Fist who befriends Ken.

etretta_fulvrie.name: Etretta Fulvrie

canon_ref.note: Killed shielding Daly from lightning (1.06D).

etretta_fulvrie.summary: A veteran Dullahan of Gravetender's Fist, first in her group's armour rank.

calectus.name: Calectus

canon_ref.note: Leads the Selphids serving Geneva. Called he in a Lizardman body, she after taking a Dullahan body (1.06D).

calectus.summary: A senior Selphid who guards Geneva, hoping she can cure the Selphids' Wasting.

xalandrass.name: Xalandrass

canon_ref.note: Xal. A war vendor; sold the Evercut arrows.

xalandrass.summary: A jewelled Naga war vendor who trades with Ken and stands with the cleanup companies when the battle turns on them.

exara.name: Exara

canon_ref.note: Rot's Bane is named as her company in 1.06D.

exara.summary: The disciplined Centaur captain of Rot's Bane, a small cleanup company.

ulvial.name: Ulvial

canon_ref.note: Species not stated. Spelled Ulviel once. Killed in 1.06D.

ulvial.summary: The bald captain of Untimely Demise, who told Quallet of the valley battle.

zalthia_werskiv.name: Zalthia Werskiv

canon_ref.note: The Firebringer, of Tripartite Law. Species not stated. Geneva says she destroyed the Raverian Fighters.

zalthia_werskiv.summary: A flying fire mage who burns armies and Geneva's camp for pay.

grishka.name: Grishka

canon_ref.note: The War Walker Geneva saves is her brother.

grishka.summary: A Razorshard Armor commander who pays Geneva for saving her brother.

timbor_parithad.name: Timbor Parithad

canon_ref.note: Owns the Drunken Swordsman in Celum. Race is a guess.

timbor_parithad.summary: A Celum innkeeper who comes to scold Erin over the fired barmaids and hires them.

ulia_ovena.name: Ulia Ovena

canon_ref.note: Owns the Blazehound in Celum; has a charm Skill. Race is a guess.

ulia_ovena.summary: A charming Celum innkeeper who comes with Timbor and Agnes to confront Erin.

wiskeria.name: Wiskeria

canon_ref.note: Wears glasses. Becomes Laken's [General] (Level 4, stated) in 4.23 E. Race is a guess.

wiskeria.summary: A sharp Witch of the Celestial Trackers who stays at Riverfarm and becomes Laken's General.

beniar.name: Beniar

canon_ref.note: Leader of the Windfrozen Riders, a boastful Silver-rank swordsman (4.19). Race is a guess.

beniar.summary: The brash leader of the Windfrozen Riders who trains Riverfarm's militia.

sacra.name: Sacra

canon_ref.note: Posed as Odveig, leader of the Celestial Trackers, until 4.22 E. Says spying is not her class.

sacra.summary: Magnolia's agent who led the Celestial Trackers as 'Odveig' to watch Laken, then fled.

helm.name: Helm

canon_ref.note: From Windrest; short of iron at Riverfarm.

helm.summary: Windrest's blacksmith who brings word of the Goblin raid and moves to Riverfarm.

jelov.name: Jelov

canon_ref.note: Elderly and limping. His heir is called a granddaughter once and a daughter once.

jelov.summary: An old carver who makes Laken's marker poles.

canon_ref.note: Survived the avalanche.

rehanna.name: Rehanna

canon_ref.note: The name is given with a hedge.

rehanna.summary: A woman of Windrest who challenges Laken in public and is forced to kneel.

jeighya.name: Jeighya

canon_ref.note: Race is a guess.

jeighya.summary: A scout of the Celestial Trackers who examines the dead Goblin.

fabiel.name: Fabiel

canon_ref.note: Killed in a Goblin ambush (4.21 E); body never found (4.22 E).

fabiel.summary: A Windfrozen Rider killed by Goblins while hunting with Beniar.

rie.name: Rie

canon_ref.note: Only a letter; no surname given.

rie.summary: A [Lady] of Invrisil who writes to Laken after the battle.

welsca_crimsonscale.name: Welsca Crimsonscale

canon_ref.note: Red scales and an arm scar. Her home city is not stated.

welsca_crimsonscale.summary: An older Drake, Wall Lord Ilvriss' aide, who presses Ryoka about Periss in a bathhouse and is kicked into a pool.

foliana.name: Foliana

canon_ref.note: Squirrel Beastkin, the 'Three-Color Stalker'.

foliana.summary: Leader of the Forgotten Wing Company, a [Rogue] who vanishes at will, and Niers' oldest friend.

peclir_im.name: Peclir Im

canon_ref.note: About four years in the company's service.

peclir_im.summary: The Forgotten Wing's [Chamberlain], who runs its fundraiser at Elvallian.

wil.name: Wil

canon_ref.note: No surname in this chapter.

wil.summary: One of Niers' advanced students. He writes to a Zeres [Strategist] and brings Niers Olesm's newsletter.

yerranola.name: Yerranola

canon_ref.note: Wears a male Naga body; she is female.

yerranola.summary: A Selphid among Niers' advanced students.

wullst.name: Wullst

canon_ref.note: A former [Rider].

wullst.summary: [Mayor] of Leadenfurt, squeezed between Tyrion's levy and Magnolia's.

regis_reinhart.name: Regis Reinhart

canon_ref.note: Kept by necromancy; dead about 3,800 years.

regis_reinhart.summary: A long-dead Reinhart who guards the family vault with four ghost [Maids].

bea.name: Bea

canon_ref.note: 4.28: she and Kerash killed Periss' soldiers. M18.7 (4.49): her power is a plague touch that healing potions make worse.

bea.summary: One of Az'kerash's Chosen: a rotting undead woman whose touch carries a plague. She scries Ryoka running for the High Passes.

kerash.name: Kerash

canon_ref.note: An undead Gnoll as tall as Venitra, with an axe (4.28; he uses a magic sword in 4.49). 4.28: he and Bea killed Periss' soldiers.

kerash.summary: One of Az'kerash's Chosen: a giant undead Gnoll, with an axe in Book 5 and a magic sword in 4.49. After Venitra fails, the Necromancer gives him his authority.

oom.name: Oom

canon_ref.note: One of the two eldest Chosen with Ijvani (4.28). M18.7 (4.49): Oom is a sentient Acid Slime in a coat with a fist-sized mana-stone core.

oom.summary: One of Az'kerash's eldest Chosen: dark and faceless in a long coat and hat, made to kill warriors like Zel Shivertail. An Acid Slime with a mana-stone core; Zel destroys him (4.49).
